units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6">Gen. R. s. 6</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:17">Ex. R. s. 15</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00265"><he>בּוּלִי</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: popular gathering, public festival with games (δημοτικὸς ἀγών) given by Emperors or high officials and connected with amnesty; in gen. amnesty, pardon.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:2">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite> when the king <he>נותן ד׳</he> grants a general pardon, opp. <cite ref="O01368"><he>ספיקולה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 63a:10">Kidd. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>עשה כד׳ הזה</he> act as was done in that public game (Ar. <cite ref="D01058"><he>דְּרוֹמוֹס</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29">Lev. R. s. 29</cite>, a. fr. <he>יצא בד׳</he> he was pardoned.

Gen. R. s. 79 when he heard a divine voice say ד׳ ד׳ demos, demos (pardon), the bird escaped, opp. ספיקולא; Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ top; Pesik. B’shall. p. 88ᵇ דיניס (corr. acc.); a. fr.—[Ex. R. s. 2, beg. ינתן בד׳, v. דִּימוֹסִין.—
Gen. R. s. 8 דִּימוֹסָהּ, v. דִּימוֹסְיָא.]—Pl. דִּימוֹסִין public games.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:12">Cant. R. to VII, 12</cite> <he>נטייל בד׳ וכ׳</he> let us take a walk among (observe) the amusements of the world.
